description: Use when you or the user must choose a tool, API or provider for a task (send email, take payments, host a database…): send the task in a few plain words ('send an invoice') with filters if they matter. Returns the products our agent drove for it, ranked by how far an agent got on its own (sign-up, key, the work, paying), each with what happened and its sign-up, docs and MCP links. Read-only, no key needed; 5 by default, up to 25; a product by name: search_tools.

access.description: Only products our agent got into without a person

brief.description: true (default): each product with its next steps; false: every field

capability.description: Instead of task: a capability id (GET /api/capabilities) or name

category.description: Only this category id or name (list_categories)

min_level.description: Only products at this agent level (0-5) or higher

pays_with.description: Only products that take x402, mpp or card; a comma list takes any, e.g. x402,mpp

self_signup.description: true: only products our agent got a key for without a person

surface.description: Only products an agent can work by api, mcp, cli or sdk; a comma list wants all, e.g. mcp,cli

task.description: The task in plain words, e.g. 'send an invoice'; or send capability

name: choose_provider_for_task
title: Choose a provider
